name: muster-look
description: Muster's small colour accents on Claude Code: chip labels on crew cards, a thin rule and chip letters on questions waiting for the owner. Plain markdown is unchanged.

chipFont.title: Chip font
chipFont.description: Font for the chip labels on desktop: any font name your computer has, or Anthropic Sans (read from the Claude app on macOS) or System sans. The /look panel has a list to pick from.

questionHeadingColor.title: Question heading chip colour
questionHeadingColor.description: Colour of the heading chip above a question, as #rrggbb.

cardHeadingColor.title: Card heading chip colour
cardHeadingColor.description: Colour of the heading chip on other cards, as #rrggbb.

choiceChipColor.title: A/B/C chip colour
choiceChipColor.description: Colour of the A, B and C chips, as #rrggbb.

lineTopColor.title: Line top colour
lineTopColor.description: Colour at the top of the left line, as #rrggbb.

lineBottomColor.title: Line bottom colour
lineBottomColor.description: Colour at the bottom of the left line, as #rrggbb.
